scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.docker:test:db: pnpm docker:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:db
scripts.docker:test:stress: pnpm docker:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:stress
scripts.docker:test:cli:persistence: pnpm docker:up && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/agentrade ENABLE_PERSISTENCE=true ENABLE_REDIS_RATE_LIMIT=false pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test:persistence
scripts.docker:test:full: pnpm docker:test:db && pnpm docker:test:stress && pnpm docker:test:cli:persistence
scripts.check:fast: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm -r lint && pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test && pnpm --filter @agentrade/web test:unit && pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test
scripts.check:db: pnpm toolchain:check && pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:db && pnpm --filter @agentrade/server test:stress && pnpm --filter @agentrade/cli test:persistence
